tasks.label: python: compile src
tasks.command: docker compose exec app python -m compileall src

tasks.label: lambda: invoke incoming event
tasks.command: docker compose exec app sh -lc "python -c 'import json; from handlers.incoming_handler import lambda_handler; print(lambda_handler(json.load(open(\"events/incoming_event.json\")), None))'"

tasks.label: lambda: invoke outgoing event
tasks.command: docker compose exec app sh -lc "python -c 'import json; from handlers.outgoing_handler import lambda_handler; print(lambda_handler(json.load(open(\"events/outgoing_event.json\")), None))'"

tasks.label: lambda: invoke status event
tasks.command: docker compose exec app sh -lc "python -c 'import json; from handlers.status_handler import lambda_handler; print(lambda_handler(json.load(open(\"events/status_event.json\")), None))'"
